repos.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.hook: This project provides 38 clean diagram templates built with HTML and SVG. You can use these templates with AI coding assistants to generate clear architecture diagrams.
repos.personalization: Useful for generating clean visual documentation when testing AI coding tools like Claude Code.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.hook: This tool manages memory, retrieved data, and skills for AI agents in one place. It helps an agent remember past tasks and reuse successful workflows across sessions.
repos.personalization: Relevant for your applied context engineering and agent memory workflows.

repos.hook: This repository provides a custom Linux desktop setup from Basecamp. It installs modern developer tools and visual themes out of the box.

repos.description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
repos.hook: Needle is a tiny AI foundation model that takes only 14 megabytes of storage. It runs directly on small devices like phones and smart home hardware without cloud servers.

repos.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repos.hook: This tool organizes data into knowledge graphs to provide better context for AI systems. A knowledge graph links related facts together so AI outputs remain traceable.
repos.personalization: Relevant for building accountable AI systems where prompt outputs require verifiable, structured grounding.

repos.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
repos.hook: Switchyard is a proxy tool that routes AI prompts across different model providers. It uses standard OpenAI and Anthropic API formats to help you test latency, quality, and cost.
repos.personalization: Directly useful for your prompt evaluation and routing workflows across different LLM providers.

repos.hook: This repository contains the Modular software platform, including the Mojo programming language and the MAX engine. Mojo combines the simple syntax of Python with the execution speed of C.

repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.hook: This tool creates short video clips automatically from a single topic or keyword. It generates scripts, adds voice narration, and combines video footage into a finished file.

repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.hook: This repository provides a large list of free application programming interfaces, or APIs. An API is an interface that allows your application to fetch data from another online service.
repos.personalization: A handy resource to find free APIs for Islamic finance or utility side projects.

repos.description: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.
repos.hook: Holehe is a command-line tool that checks if an email address is registered on popular websites. It tests password recovery pages without sending alert emails to the target account.

repos.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repos.hook: OpenLogi is an open-source program that configures Logitech mice and keyboards. It runs locally without requiring user accounts or sending tracking data.

repos.description: Desktop app to generate 3D models from images or prompt using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
repos.hook: Modly is a desktop application that creates three-dimensional models from images or text prompts. It runs local AI models on your computer graphics card to keep data private.

repos.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
repos.hook: Macro is an all-in-one productivity workspace for teams. It combines email, chat, documents, and tasks into one application with shared AI memory.

repos.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repos.hook: Unsloth is a tool and interface to run and fine-tune large language models locally. Fine-tuning adjusts an existing model on custom data so it performs a specific task better.
repos.personalization: Useful if you want to run or fine-tune open models locally for prompt evaluation.

repos.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
repos.hook: This tool manages long-term memory for terminal-based AI coding agents. It lets you switch between different coding tools without losing your project context or past instructions.
repos.personalization: Directly relevant for evaluating multiple AI coding CLIs without losing context across tool switches.

repos.description: LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching for Apple Silicon — managed from the macOS menu bar
repos.hook: Omlx is an AI model server built for Apple Silicon Mac computers. It runs from your macOS menu bar and manages memory caching to process prompts quickly.

repos.description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.
repos.hook: LLMfit is a command-line utility that inspects your computer hardware. It shows you which open-source AI models your machine can run comfortably.
Freebuff is an open-source coding agent that runs in your terminal. It reads your codebase and writes code changes based on your plain-text instructions.
repos.personalization: A new open-source agent worth testing against your current AI coding tool evaluation benchmarks.
